title: Roasted Carrots and Leeks with Fresh Mint
blurb: Sweet roasted carrots and tender leeks finished with fresh mint. A simple side dish that works well with roasted meats or as part of a vegetarian spread.
steps: Wash the leeks thoroughly to remove any grit between the layers, then cut into 2 cm pieces. Peel the carrots and slice into 1 cm rounds.
Put the carrots and leeks in a roasting tin, drizzle with the olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss everything together so the vegetables are evenly coated.
Roast for 45 to 50 minutes, turning the vegetables once or twice, until they are tender and starting to caramelise at the edges.
Roughly chop the mint leaves and scatter over the roasted vegetables just before serving.
